ov: Fish that puff up into a ball when threatened. Most species are toxic, some among the most poisonous vertebrates in the world, because their organs and sometimes skin contain tetrodotoxin.

why.dg: Eating the wrong parts is often fatal: the liver and sometimes the skin carry tetrodotoxin.
why.et: It is a delicacy in Japan (fugu), Korea and China, prepared only by specially trained chefs.

fx: Its close relative the porcupinefish has large spines; a puffer’s thin spines show only when it inflates.
